# Control Narrative: Kiln Heat-up and Start-up

**Document:** CN-KLN-100, Section: Heat-up and Start-up. **Status:** Draft A, for review. **Module code:** KLN.

I built this section from the shift notes only. Where the notes were vague ("around", "every so often", "a few hours", "keep it low"), I proposed a value and marked it **confirm** in the setpoint list. Tag numbers are provisional because I have no instrument index. The notes do not cover precalciner firing, cooler start, hood pressure, or ESP energizing, so I list those as open items (OI-02).

---

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

**Purpose.** This section defines the controlled cold start of kiln KL-100 from a stopped, cold state to the start of normal running. It covers heat-up on diesel, fuel changeover to coal, kiln rotation, feed start, and feed ramp.

**Interfaces.**

| Interface | Direction | Content |
|---|---|---|
| Burner management (BMS/SIS) | Both | Purge request, light-off request, flame proof, fuel trip. SIS logic is in the SRS. |
| Coal system | In | Coal ready, coal flow feedback |
| ID fan FN-200 | Both | Speed command, speed feedback, run status |
| ESP-500 | Out | De-energize command |
| Raw meal feed system | Out | Feed rate setpoint, feeder status |
| Emergency power | In | Source healthy, transfer complete |
| Normal-running section | Out | Hand-off at end of KLN-FEED-RAMP |
| Shutdown section | In | Controlled stop is outside this section |

---

## 3. States and transitions

### 3.1 State table (ISA-106)

| State | Description | Entry permissives | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|
| KLN-COLD | Kiln stopped, no fire. AD-100 rotates on schedule. | None | Automatic (rotation) |
| KLN-READY | Pre-start checks complete | AD-100 available; emergency power healthy; FN-200 available; BMS healthy; ESP-500 available; SCN-600 running; TI-301 and AIT-401 good quality | Automatic checks |
| KLN-HEAT-DIESEL | Main burner on diesel, low fire | Purge complete; flame proven; FN-200 at or above firing minimum | Operator-prompted |
| KLN-CHANGEOVER | Diesel replaced by coal | TI-301 at or above changeover temperature; coal system ready; rotation on schedule; no CO alarm | Operator-prompted start, automatic execution |
| KLN-HEAT-COAL | Main burner on coal | Coal flame proven; diesel closed | Operator-prompted |
| KLN-FEED-RAMP | Feed started and raised to target | Feed-start permissives in SP list (see FR-KLN-040) | Automatic after prompt |
| KLN-HOLD | Fuel and feed held. Rotation continues. | Any hold condition (Section 3.3) | Automatic entry, manual exit |
| KLN-TRIP | Fuel and feed off | Any trip in Section 6 | Automatic entry, manual reset |

### 3.2 Transition table

| ID | From | To | Condition | Initiator |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| T-01 | COLD | READY | START PREP pushed; checks pass | Operator |
| T-02 | READY | HEAT-DIESEL | START HEAT-UP pushed; SQ-A complete | Operator |
| T-03 | HEAT-DIESEL | CHANGEOVER | TI-301 at or above SP-KLN-006; operator confirms | Operator |
| T-04 | CHANGEOVER | HEAT-COAL | SQ-B complete | Auto |
| T-05 | HEAT-COAL | FEED-RAMP | Feed-start permissives true; operator confirms | Operator |
| T-06 | FEED-RAMP | Normal running | Feed at target; ramp complete | Auto |
| T-07 | HEAT-DIESEL, CHANGEOVER, HEAT-COAL, FEED-RAMP | HOLD | Any hold condition | Auto |
| T-08 | HOLD | State before hold | Hold condition clear; operator pushes RESUME | Operator |
| T-09 | Any firing state, HOLD | TRIP | Any trip in Section 6 | Auto |
| T-10 | TRIP | READY | Trip cause clear; operator pushes RESET | Operator |
| T-11 | READY, HOLD | COLD | Operator pushes ABORT; fuel closed | Operator |

### 3.3 Hold conditions

- Heat-up rate above the hold limit (SP-KLN-003).
- Rotation overdue (AL-KLN-002).
- CO above the CO alarm value.
- Shell hot spot alarm.
- Back-end temperature PV bad.
- Sequence step timeout.
- Operator prompt not acknowledged within TO-KLN-09.

### 3.4 Requirements: states

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-001 | The system shall allow only the transitions in Section 3.2. | FAT: force each transition; attempt each non-listed transition. |
| FR-KLN-002 | The system shall not enter a state unless its entry permissives are true. | FAT: remove each permissive in turn. |
| FR-KLN-003 | In KLN-HOLD, the system shall not raise fuel flow or feed rate. | FAT: enter Hold; command an increase. |
| FR-KLN-004 | After a trip, the system shall return to KLN-READY only after the operator pushes RESET. | FAT: clear cause; confirm no auto-reset. |
| FR-KLN-005 | The system shall retain the current state and last rotation time through a controller restart. | FAT: power-cycle the controller. |

## 4. Regulatory control

| Loop | PV | Output | Action | Mode behavior | Cascade / override |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Heat-up rate | TI-301 rate of rise, averaged over the window in SP-KLN-004 | Fuel flow setpoint (FCV-110 in diesel, FIC-120 in coal) | Reverse | Auto in heat-up states. Manual forces the operator to set the fuel. | Cascades to fuel flow. Fuel increase is blocked above the hold limit. |
| Diesel flow | Diesel flow | FCV-110 | Direct | Auto or manual | Limited to the diesel firing limit (SP-KLN-005) |
| Coal flow | Coal flow | FIC-120 | Direct | Auto or manual | Ramp-in per SQ-B |
| ID fan speed | FN-200 speed | SIC-200 | Per fan design | Auto or manual | Output low limit is the firing minimum (SP-KLN-009) while any fuel is on |
| Draft | PIC-210 | Draft damper | Per damper design | Auto or manual | Draft damper moves first. FN-200 speed never goes below the firing minimum. |
| Kiln feed | FIC-700 | Feeder speed | Direct | Auto in FEED-RAMP | Ramp per SQ-D. Feed increase is blocked in Hold. |

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-010 | The system shall limit the back-end temperature rise to the maximum in SP-KLN-002 by limiting fuel increase. | FAT: simulate a fast TI-301 rise; confirm fuel increase blocked. |
| FR-KLN-011 | The system shall limit the diesel flow to the diesel firing limit (SP-KLN-005) in KLN-HEAT-DIESEL. | FAT: command flow above the limit. |
| FR-KLN-012 | While any fuel is on, the system shall limit the SIC-200 output to the firing minimum or above. | FAT: command SIC-200 below the minimum in Auto and Manual. |
| FR-KLN-013 | The system shall hold draft with PIC-210 through the damper while FN-200 is at its minimum. | FAT: simulate a draft deviation at minimum speed. |

## 5. Sequences

Timeouts and values are in the setpoint list (Section 11). A failed step raises AL-KLN-011 unless a row says otherwise.

### 5.1 SQ-C: Kiln rotation (runs in parallel from KLN-READY until main drive takeover)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | Select the index interval from the TI-301 band table (SP-KLN-015 to 018). | Interval timer expires | None | None |
| C2 | Command AD-100 to index by the index angle (SP-KLN-014). | Index complete on SI-100 | TO-KLN-02 | Retry once. Then raise AL-KLN-001, enter Hold, prompt manual rotation. |
| C3 | Reset the interval timer. | Timer running | TO-KLN-01 | Raise AL-KLN-002 if the interval plus margin (SP-KLN-019) passes without an index. |
| C4 | At TI-301 at or above SP-KLN-012, prompt P-05 to transfer to the main drive. | Operator confirms | TO-KLN-09 | Stay on AD-100. Repeat prompt. |
| C5 | Stop AD-100. Start MD-100 at the slow speed (SP-KLN-013). | SI-100 at slow speed | TO-KLN-10 | Restart AD-100. Raise AL-KLN-001. Enter Hold. |

### 5.2 SQ-A: Light-off and diesel heat-up (READY to HEAT-DIESEL)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | Check rotation on schedule (SQ-C running). | AD-100 healthy; no AL-KLN-002 | TO-KLN-01 | Stay in READY. Raise AL-KLN-001. |
| A2 | Start FN-200. Raise speed to the firing minimum. | SIC-200 at or above SP-KLN-009; PIC-210 in Auto | TO-KLN-12 | Stay in READY. Raise AL-KLN-005. |
| A3 | Request purge from BMS. | Purge complete from BMS | TO-KLN-03 | Cancel the request. Stay unfired. Raise AL-KLN-011. |
| A4 | Request diesel light-off at the diesel firing limit or lower. | Flame proven by BMS | Per SRS | BMS closes XV-110. Enter TRIP. A new purge is required before retry. |
| A5 | Adjust diesel flow to hold the rise in the target band (SP-KLN-001, 002). | TI-301 at or above SP-KLN-006 | TO-KLN-13 | Raise AL-KLN-011. Enter Hold. |
| A5a | If the rise stays below the minimum target for the low-rate time, prompt P-02. | Operator raises diesel or accepts | TO-KLN-14 | Raise AL-KLN-004. Keep fire unchanged. |

### 5.3 SQ-B: Changeover from diesel to coal

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | Check changeover permissives (Section 3.1). | All true | TO-KLN-09 | Stay on diesel. Raise AL-KLN-011. |
| B2 | Prompt P-03. | Operator confirms | TO-KLN-09 | Stay on diesel. Repeat prompt. |
| B3 | Start coal at the lowest flow. | Coal flame proven by BMS | TO-KLN-05 | Stop coal. Keep diesel. Raise AL-KLN-013. Enter Hold. |
| B4 | Ramp coal up over SP-KLN-007. Ramp diesel down over SP-KLN-008. | Coal at target; diesel at zero; rise within band | TO-KLN-15 | Freeze both ramps. Enter Hold. |
| B5 | Close XV-110. | XV-110 closed | TO-KLN-06 | Raise AL-KLN-011. Keep Hold until the operator confirms the valve closed. |

### 5.4 SQ-D: Feed start and ramp

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | Check feed-start permissives (FR-KLN-040). | All true | TO-KLN-09 | Stay in HEAT-COAL. Raise AL-KLN-011. |
| D2 | Prompt P-04. | Operator confirms | TO-KLN-09 | Stay in HEAT-COAL. Repeat prompt. |
| D3 | Start the feeder at the initial feed (SP-KLN-023). | FIC-700 flow confirmed | TO-KLN-07 | Stop the feeder. Enter Hold. |
| D4 | Raise feed by the step (SP-KLN-025) at each interval (SP-KLN-026). | Step reached; permissives true | TO-KLN-08 | Freeze feed. Enter Hold. |
| D5 | Stop at target feed. Hand off to the normal-running section. | Target reached | TO-KLN-16 | Hold feed at the current value. Raise AL-KLN-011. |

### 5.5 Sequence requirements

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-020 | The system shall run SQ-C from KLN-READY until takeover by MD-100. | FAT: simulate; check indexing in each band. |
| FR-KLN-021 | The system shall select a shorter index interval in each higher TI-301 band. | FAT: step TI-301 through the bands. |
| FR-KLN-022 | The system shall raise AL-KLN-002 if an index is overdue. | FAT: block the index; wait. |
| FR-KLN-023 | The system shall start the main burner only after FN-200 is at or above the firing minimum and purge is complete. | FAT: remove each condition. |
| FR-KLN-024 | The system shall not open the coal flow before TI-301 is at or above SP-KLN-006 and the operator confirms. | FAT: attempt coal start below and above. |
| FR-KLN-025 | The system shall keep diesel on until coal flame is proven. | FAT: fail the coal flame proof at B3. |
| FR-KLN-026 | Each step in Section 5 shall time out as listed and apply its failure response. | FAT: block each transition condition. |

## 6. Interlocks and permissives

No cause-and-effect chart was supplied, so the rows are written here (OI-04 for SRS classification).

| ID | Cause | Effect | Latched or auto-reset | Reset method |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IL-01 | FN-200 speed below the firing minimum for longer than TO-KLN-18, with fuel on | BMS closes all fuel. State goes to TRIP. | Latched | Speed above minimum; new purge; operator RESET |
| IL-02 | AIT-401 CO above the CO trip value | ESP-500 de-energizes. BPCS enters Hold. | Latched | CO below reset value for the reset time; operator RESET |
| IL-03 | AIT-401 bad quality for longer than TO-KLN-19, with fuel on | ESP-500 de-energizes. BPCS enters Hold. | Latched | Analyzer good; operator RESET |
| IL-04 | Heat-up rate above the hold limit | Block fuel increase. Enter Hold. | Auto-reset | Rate below limit; operator RESUME |
| IL-05 | TI-601 above hot spot alarm value | Enter Hold. Raise AL-KLN-008. | Auto-reset | Value below alarm; operator RESUME |
| IL-06 | TI-601 above hot spot high-high value | Raise AL-KLN-009. Prompt P-06 to start shutdown. | Latched alarm | Operator acknowledgement |
| IL-07 | Rotation overdue | Enter Hold. Raise AL-KLN-002. | Auto-reset | Index complete; operator RESUME |
| IL-08 | Loss of power | See Section 8.3 | See Section 8.3 | See Section 8.3 |

**SIS references.** IL-01 (fuel trip on low ID fan speed) and IL-02 (ESP trip on high CO) are protective functions. The SRS owns their logic, trip values, and SIL. This narrative states the intended behavior so FAT can test it. The BPCS does not replace the SIS action.

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-030 | The system shall implement IL-01 to IL-08 as written in the table. | FAT: inject each cause; check effect, latching, and reset. |
| FR-KLN-031 | IL-02 shall de-energize ESP-500 when AIT-401 exceeds the CO trip value, in any state with fuel on. | FAT: inject CO above trip value. |
| FR-KLN-032 | The ESP shall not re-energize until the CO reset conditions in SP-KLN-029 and 030 are met and the operator pushes RESET. | FAT: lower CO; check ESP stays off until RESET. |
| FR-KLN-040 | The system shall allow feed start only when all hold: TI-301 at or above SP-KLN-020; TI-310 at or above SP-KLN-022; MD-100 running; FN-200 at or above minimum; coal flame proven; no CO alarm; no hot spot alarm; rotation on schedule. | FAT: remove each condition. |

| ID | Alarm | Priority | Operator response |

| AL-KLN-001 | AD-100 or MD-100 failed to rotate | High | Start manual rotation. Call maintenance. |

| AL-KLN-010 | TI-301 bad PV | High | Use TI-302. Keep Hold. |
| AL-KLN-011 | Sequence step timeout | Medium | Read the step message. Fix the cause. |
| AL-KLN-012 | Emergency power for AD-100 not available | High | Restore the source. Prepare manual rotation. |

## 8. Abnormal handling

### 8.1 Bad PV

| PV | Detection | Response |
|---|---|---|
| TI-301 | Out of range, or differs from TI-302 by more than the allowed difference | Switch to TI-302. If both are bad, enter Hold. Rotation continues at the shortest interval. Raise AL-KLN-010. |
| TI-310 | Out of range | Block feed start. Continue heat-up. |
| AIT-401 | Bad quality | See IL-03. |
| SI-100 | Bad quality | Treat the kiln as not rotating. Raise AL-KLN-001. |
| TI-601 / SCN-600 | Scanner fault | Enter Hold. Prompt the operator for manual shell checks. |
| FIC-700 | Out of range during feed | Stop the feed increase. Enter Hold. |

### 8.2 Communication loss

| Link | Response |
|---|---|
| BPCS to BMS | The BMS keeps its own protection. The BPCS enters Hold and blocks fuel increase. |
| BPCS to AD-100 | AD-100 continues indexing at the last commanded interval. Raise AL-KLN-001. |
| BPCS to FN-200 | FN-200 holds its last speed. The BPCS enters Hold. |
| BPCS to feeder | The feeder holds its last rate. Enter Hold. |

### 8.3 Power loss and restart

**On power loss:**
- The BMS closes all fuel valves. Feed stops. ESP-500 de-energizes.
- AD-100 starts on emergency power within TO-KLN-17.
- After the start, AD-100 indexes at the shortest interval until power returns and TI-301 is known.

**On power return:**
- The state is TRIP.
- The operator pushes RESET after checking AD-100 and FN-200.
- Re-light needs a new purge and FN-200 at or above the firing minimum.
- Feed start needs all permissives in FR-KLN-040 again.

**If AD-100 cannot start,** raise AL-KLN-001 and AL-KLN-012. Prompt manual rotation. Manual turning is outside this section (OI-03).

### 8.4 Fail positions (provisional, confirm)

| Device | Fail position |
|---|---|
| XV-110 diesel shutoff | Closed |
| FCV-110 | Closed |
| FIC-120 coal | Closed (feeder stops) |
| Kiln feeder | Stopped |
| Draft damper | Hold last position |
| AD-100 | Runs on emergency power |

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-050 | The system shall apply the Section 8.1 response to each bad PV. | FAT: force each PV bad. |
| FR-KLN-051 | The system shall apply the Section 8.2 response to each link loss. | FAT: disconnect each link. |
| FR-KLN-052 | On power loss, AD-100 shall start on emergency power within TO-KLN-17. | SAT: trip main power with the kiln hot. |
| FR-KLN-053 | After power return, the system shall stay in TRIP until the operator pushes RESET. | FAT: restore power; check state. |
| FR-KLN-054 | Each device shall go to its fail position in Section 8.4. | SAT: remove power and air to each device. |

## 9. Operator interface

**The operator sees:**
- State name and active sequence step.
- TI-301, TI-302, TI-310, and heat-up rate against the target band.
- Time since last index, and time to next index.
- FN-200 speed against the firing minimum.
- AIT-401 CO value and ESP-500 status.
- TI-601 and the SCN-600 trend.
- Feed rate and ramp progress.

**The operator can:** start, hold, resume, abort, reset, confirm prompts, set fuel in Manual, and command a manual index.

**Prompts** (STE wording):

| ID | Prompt |
|---|---|
| P-01 | Push START HEAT-UP to light the burner on diesel. |
| P-02 | The temperature rise is low. Raise the diesel flow, or push ACCEPT. |
| P-03 | Back-end temperature is at the changeover value. Push CONFIRM to change to coal. |
| P-04 | Check the shell scanner. Push CONFIRM to start the kiln feed. |
| P-05 | Push CONFIRM to move the kiln from the auxiliary drive to the main drive. |
| P-06 | Hot spot is very high. Push SHUTDOWN, or push CANCEL after you check the shell. |
| P-07 | Do not push RESET until CO is low. |

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-060 | The system shall show the items above and issue prompts P-01 to P-07 with the stated wording. | FAT: walk through each screen. |
| FR-KLN-061 | Operations shall sign off the states and prompts before FAT. | Document review |
